names.name: Hovak Johnston
names.said: Put traditional marks back on Inuit women from 2016

text.what: The Inuvialuk woman whose project took the kakiniit off the archive shelf and back onto skin, learning the stitch from elders.
text.story: The revival has a method as well as a date: find the women who remember, learn the stitch from them, and put the marks on people who want them — starting with the women whose grandmothers had been told to stop.

text_th.what: หญิงชาวอินูเวียลูอิตผู้นำรอยสักดั้งเดิมออกจากชั้นเอกสารกลับมาอยู่บนผิวหนัง โดยเรียนวิธีเย็บจากผู้เฒ่า
